items.title: Koshi recognises 13 additional languages for official use
items.desc: The new provision brings the number of languages recognised for government business in the province to 14, including Nepali.

items.title: Palpa’s Dhaka cloth weaves its way from festive gifts to tourist keepsakes
items.desc: Growing demand for Dhaka products as gifts for brothers and relatives during Tihar is helping sustain a traditional craft that embodies Nepal’s cultural identity, even as local production and employment decline.

items.title: Nepal’s push for Himalayan climate agenda falls short at COP31
items.desc: Proposal by Nepal, Bhutan and Kyrgyzstan fails to secure a separate place in formal negotiations; Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal says lack of support from major negotiating blocs remains a hurdle.

items.title: Behind Bangladesh’s garment boom, workers cut food, healthcare as wages fall short
items.desc: Bangladesh’s garment workers say stagnant wages and rising living costs are forcing families to cut back on food, forgo healthcare and pull children out of school, even as the industry drives the country’s export economy.

items.title: Karnali announces trials for 14 sports ahead of National Games
items.desc: Provincial selections will run from November 13 to 20, while athletes in 31 disciplines will undergo closed-camp training ahead of the December 2-13 competition.

items.title: Nepal celebrates Bhai Tika, the final day of Tihar
items.desc: Sisters apply colourful tika to their brothers, praying for their long life, good health and prosperity in a festival rooted in religious belief and family bonds.

items.title: Woman killed in elephant attack in Kanchanpur
items.desc: A herd of elephants entered a settlement inside Shuklaphanta National Park, damaged a house and trampled a 60-year-old woman to death while she was asleep.

items.title: Pakistan blames India’s Diwali fireworks for Lahore’s toxic air
items.desc: Pakistan says winds carried pollution from Diwali fireworks in India into Lahore, pushing the city’s air quality index to 263 and making it the world’s most polluted major city for a second consecutive day.

items.title: US jury finds Naresh Bhatt guilty of murdering wife Mamta Kafle
items.desc: The Virginia jury also convicted Bhatt of concealing and defiling his wife’s body, which has never been found. He had claimed she died by suicide before he dismembered and disposed of her remains.

items.title: Nepal PM’s India visit to cover entire spectrum of bilateral ties, says New Delhi
items.desc: Kathmandu is seeking progress on reconstruction assistance, air connectivity, energy cooperation and longstanding bilateral issues as the two sides discuss arrangements for the prime minister’s visit.

items.title: Sudurpaschim win sends both Royals and Kathmandu Gorkhas into playoffs
items.desc: Sudurpaschim Royals secure a third consecutive victory with a 27-run win, while Janakpur Bolts are left facing elimination after another batting collapse.

items.title: Harmeet Singh’s four-wicket haul restricts Sudurpaschim Royals to 120
items.desc: The Janakpur Bolts captain takes four wickets for 17 runs as Sudurpaschim struggle to build a competitive total in a crucial Nepal Premier League match.

items.title: Indian anti-dumping duties put Nepal’s jute industry under pressure
items.desc: Higher duties in its biggest export market, coupled with the withdrawal of government incentives at home, are squeezing eastern Nepal’s jute industry, threatening its competitiveness, exports and jobs.

items.title: Russia and Ukraine hold US-backed talks after Trump says broad deal is possible
items.desc: Russian state news agency RIA reported the start of what is scheduled to be two days of talks, in which Trump’s envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are to mediate between the two warring sides.

items.title: Explained: Why is Sheikh Hasina’s plan to return to Bangladesh contentious?
items.desc: The former prime minister says she plans to return in December, despite a death sentence, the revocation of her travel documents and the risk of arrest.

items.title: Who is Alice Huang, the Chinese businesswoman tied to Nvidia’s CEO?
items.desc: Former Chinese finance executive Alice Huang became Megaspeed International’s controlling shareholder in 2023 and is under scrutiny over alleged espionage links to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

items.title: Seven held for setting off firecrackers in Rupandehi, one injured
items.desc: Police say two of those detained were involved in an incident in which a person was injured during a Bhailo programme.

items.title: Madhesh prepares for Chhath as families return home
items.desc: As preparations gather pace across the Tarai, the festival is bringing families together and boosting seasonal trade.

items.title: Living alongside rhinos on the fringes of Chitwan
items.desc: From Nagarban to nearby settlements, rhinos regularly venture out in search of food, bringing people and wildlife into close contact and raising concerns over safety.

items.title: Nepal urges climate justice for Himalayas at COP31
items.desc: Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal calls for a dedicated action plan for mountain regions and says limiting global warming to 1.5°C is critical to protecting the Himalayas.

items.title: Janakpur face must-win test against Sudurpaschim in NPL
items.desc: Janakpur need a victory to keep their playoff hopes alive, while Sudurpaschim can strengthen their position with a win in Kirtipur.

items.title: Students turn their school’s flower farm into a Tihar business
items.desc: With marigolds in full bloom, students of a school in Arghakhanchi are spending their holiday harvesting and selling flowers, putting their agricultural training into practice.

items.title: Traffic resumes on Prithvi Highway after overnight landslide
items.desc: The Malekhu-Muglin section reopened at 7:45am on Tuesday after debris from a fresh landslide at Ghoptebhir was cleared.

items.title: Trump says FBI is investigating Nvidia chief over alleged China spy links
items.desc: The US president says Jensen Huang told him he had no idea the Chinese businesswoman was allegedly a spy, as Nvidia launches an internal investigation and its shares fall more than 4 percent.

items.title: Kathmandu move to top with fourth straight win, beat Chitwan by 10 runs
items.desc: Ravi Bopara's half-century did not suffice as the Gorkhas defended a target of 181 to strengthen their chances of reaching the NPL playoffs.
